caption: The drawing depicts a toy-like wooden ship with four wooden wheels and a crew of eight toy soldiers. The ship is primarily brown, with cylindrical masts and rectangular railings, a raised stern cabin, and a circular window on the rear side of the cabin. The masts support two large, billowing cream-colored banners or sails. The toy soldiers are evenly spaced, with six standing on the deck, one at the front near a cannon-like structure, and one positioned high in the crow’s nest atop the main mast. The soldiers wear blue jackets, white belts, dark blue trousers, and tall blue hats with a white band. The ship is detailed with several ropes and pulleys connecting the sails, masts, and railings, all painted in shades of brown and tan. The background is off-white and unadorned, and the artist’s name, “FRANCES LICHTEN,” is written in blue in the lower right corner.
title: Toy Warship
